digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, plan-review gate, completion verifier
propositions: The code-review gate's four LLM-calling steps (base, round_a, round_b, coach) inherit a single cfg.model instead of declaring per-pass model classes, preventing Pass-1/Pass-2/Pass-4 differentiation on non-default providers.

Under a Bedrock configuration, step-level and batch model declarations are currently ignored at runtime; the gate runs all steps on cfg.model (direct Anthropic) instead of the declared class mapped through the provider.

The verifier downgrade (Pass-2/Pass-4 to sonnet-class, Pass-1 to frontier-class) does not apply on non-default providers because resolve_verifier_model is unreachable in production code, and completion.py:332 has an equivalent inversion.
A single environment variable REBAR_LLM_MODEL cannot express the operator requirement: opus-family for Pass-1, sonnet-family for Pass-2/Pass-4, across multiple passes and providers.

Per-pass model resolution requires explicit per-step class declarations (model: frontier for Pass-1 steps, model: standard for Pass-2/Pass-4 steps) that flow through the runtime interpreter instead of being discarded.
